summary: A form with one validation pattern for the whole system: client checks on submit, server errors passed by field name, each shown under its Field and listed in a summary that takes focus.

errors.repository: Repository not found. Check the owner and the name.

whenToUse: Any group of fields submitted together: connect a repository, create a token, invite reviewers.
errors for server-side validation, keyed by each Field's name.
FormActions for the button row: primary action last.
whenNotToUse: A single setting that saves on change: use Switch or an inline control without a form.
Search and filter bars that update results live: no submit, no Form.

dos.title: Validate on submit, then live
dos.text: Do not flag fields while the user is still typing for the first time. After a failed submit, errors clear as soon as the value is fixed.

dos.title: Keep what the user typed
dos.text: Show the error next to the value so it can be corrected, never clear the field.

errors.repository: Repository not found. Check the owner and the name.

donts.title: Disabling submit until the form is valid
donts.text: A disabled button explains nothing. Keep it enabled and show what is missing on submit.

donts.title: One generic error at the top
donts.text: "Something went wrong" sends users hunting. Attach each error to its field.

accessibility: Base UI Form: native form element; fields validate on submit and the first invalid field gets focus.
Server errors set aria-invalid on the control and are linked with aria-describedby.
The error summary is role alert, receives focus when new errors arrive, and links move focus to each field.
Errors are icon plus text, never color alone.
contentGuidelines: Submit buttons name the outcome: "Connect repository", not "Submit".
Server errors name the problem and the fix in one or two short sentences.
Summary title counts what to fix: "Fix 2 fields to continue".
